title: Environmental application of dicarboxylated hairy cellulose crosslinked with calcium for removal and confining of Pb(II)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00720D, Paper
T. Montesinos-Vázquez, Carlos Andres Galan-Vidal, Susana Rojas-Lima, José A. Rodríguez, Ma. Elena Páez-Hernández
DCCa is a cellulose based biopolymer which was used for the first time for removal of lead from simulated wastewater. DCCa has shown remarkable Pb(II) sorption capacity which makes it a competitive material for lead removal and confining.
